info.name: School Management Platform - MASTER API Collection (100% All Modules & Panels)
info.description:
Comprehensive Master Collection covering:
1. Super Admin Panel (School Approval, Analytics, Franchise Owners)
2. SaaS Subscription & Razorpay Gateway Panel
3. School Administrator & Authentication Panel
4. Institutional Academic & ERP Panels (Students, Teachers, Standards, Divisions, Subjects, Attendance, Fees, Exams, Timetable, Notifications)
5. Security & Expired Subscription Interceptor Tests

Equipped with automatic JWT token harvesting and dynamic ID propagation.
